rule: Truly untouched data only, fixed before any experiment result existed. Each experiment is scored once per source through tools.research_testset.score_once.

sportvu_2015_16_untouched.role: the scoring set of every tracking lane (in distribution)
sportvu_2015_16_untouched.origin: github.com/linouk23/NBA-Player-Movements data/2016.NBA.Raw.SportVU.Game.Logs at commit f7d4cf2c7e607029abfd5715a0d4073bedae328e; stored under names with a stray folder prefix, so the frozen parser never read them (docs/research/DATA.md)

skillcorner_acb_2025_26.role: out-of-distribution check (Liga ACB 2025-26 broadcast tracking, FIBA rules); reported beside the verdict, never the adoption test

broadcast_cv_2015_16.role: the scoring set of the broadcast tracking lanes (P8): 4 games in 3 whole arenas, each game scored once per experiment through score_once
broadcast_cv_2015_16.decision: PLAN.md D83, D85 (1); docs/research/P8_FEASIBILITY.md sections 4 and 7
broadcast_cv_2015_16.rule: the channel games dated without a scorebug check, taken as whole arenas (Miami, Toronto, Staples Center); chosen by a rule that reads no result. No P8 development game may be one of these games, use one of these videos or be played in one of these arenas (tools.research_testset.refuse_cv_test)
broadcast_cv_2015_16.origin_video: public third-party YouTube uploads of one channel, 720p avc1 by format listing on 2026-11-16 (CLAIMS.md standing caveat 4, amended 2026-11-17)
broadcast_cv_2015_16.origin_sportvu: github.com/linouk23/NBA-Player-Movements data/2016.NBA.Raw.SportVU.Game.Logs at commit f7d4cf2c7e607029abfd5715a0d4073bedae328e, normal file names; blob sha1 and size read from the GitHub contents API listing at that commit on 2026-11-17, sizes equal to source_bytes in the contract manifest of DATA_ROOT
broadcast_cv_2015_16.caveat: the frozen analytics models were fitted on these games' SportVU, so a swap test on them measures input substitution only; no CV model, threshold or design choice has seen their video

pending.pbp_2025_26: every 2025-26 NBA regular season game, for the play-by-play lanes (lineups, winprob). The game list is hashed into sources when its source is settled (docs/research/DATA.md flags the Sports Reference terms); no play-by-play experiment runs before that.
